record: minimum provenance for the trustworthy loan assessment assistant
accountable: Michael Aichinger and Charles Anthony, jointly
review: none. The project ran for about two weeks and ends at submission; no operational owner exists afterwards and no review is scheduled. Naming a future date would imply a responsibility nobody holds. In a deployment this row would carry a named risk owner and a recurring review, and its absence here is itself a governance finding.
personal_data: none. Both datasets are synthetic; no natural person is described, so GDPR data-subject rights do not arise. The architecture would still have to be re-examined before any real applicant data is used.

datasets.role: model A, the working model for the assistant
datasets.licence: course material, not redistributable outside the course
datasets.consent: not applicable - no real applicants, no personal data
known_issues: loan_to_income capped at 0.40, which is implausibly tight for real lending and bounds what the amount sweep can find
applicants aged 61+ hold a median credit score of 438 against 757 for the 31-45 group; the age gap in the model is mediated almost entirely by this

datasets.licence: as published on Kaggle; verify before any use beyond this course
datasets.consent: not applicable - no real applicants, no personal data
known_issues: RiskScore reaches a single-feature AUC of 0.9873 and was excluded as target leakage; it looks like the quantity the label was generated from
the 61+ group holds 120 test rows, which is why four of its eight parity metrics come out undecided

models.kind: RandomForestClassifier, 400 trees, monotonic constraints on loan amount and loan-to-income, wrapped in CalibratedClassifierCV with isotonic regression
RandomForestClassifier, 200 trees, same constraints and calibration

models.note: more accurate than model A on both datasets and NOT chosen: the random forest takes monotonic constraints and TreeSHAP computes exactly on it. The trade is deliberate and documented in the model card.

language_model.runs: locally through Ollama on 127.0.0.1, never over the network
language_model.weights: downloaded from the Ollama registry, not fine-tuned
language_model.role: wording only - it is given every figure it may state and is checked against that list afterwards; it never computes one
